## PAGE: Home
URL: https://codeguyakash.github.io/

Akash (@codeguyakash) is a Full-Stack Developer from Delhi, India. He started
learning web development in 2020. He specializes in the MERN stack (MongoDB,
Express, React, Node.js) and builds Chrome extensions published on the Chrome
Web Store.

### Chrome Extensions by Akash

**My Dark Theme**
A minimal dark theme for Chrome. Changes Chrome's UI to a clean dark mode.
Available on Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/my-dark-theme/chejinoklfdlokcdipnnccafebjekfdh

**Secure Pass**
A strong password generator Chrome extension with right-click autofill support.
Users can generate secure passwords and autofill them directly into web forms.
Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/secure-pass/ngfjlnlliapgjpcldjgblbmakhijgnhi

### Android Apps by Akash

**AutoAssist**
**AutoAssist**
A smart missed call manager that automatically replies to calls via SMS when you are busy, driving, riding, or when your phone is in your pocket. It evaluates system sensors to detect motion/travel or pocket state to trigger localized auto-reply rules.
Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.codeguyakash.assist

**Dev Launcher**
A clean, distraction-free Android launcher built for developers and productivity users who want a pure, minimal home screen experience. Features monochrome icons, dynamic themes, fast app drawer, haptic setting, and zero permissions.
Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.codeguyakash.launcher

## PAGE: Android Apps
URL: https://codeguyakash.github.io/app.html

This page lists Android apps built by Akash that are published on the Google Play Store:
- **AutoAssist**: Auto-SMS Auto-Reply missed call manager. Features Pocket Mode proximity detection, motion/travel sensor mode for safety, customized reply templates, daily limit caps, local secure sandbox processing, and activity status dashboard.
- **Dev Launcher**: Distraction-free Android launcher. Features favorite pinned apps on home screen, grid/list alphabetical scroll drawer, monochrome icons, clock/battery widgets, haptic settings, and zero permissions.

- Direct refunds outside the Chrome Web Store system are not provided.

## PAGE: Privacy Policy
URL: https://codeguyakash.github.io/privacy.html

This Privacy Policy applies to all Chrome extensions developed and published
by Akash (codeguyakash). We are committed to protecting your privacy and
ensuring full transparency.

### Data Collection & Usage
- No Personal Data Collected — None of the extensions collect, transmit, or store any personally identifiable information.
- Local Functionality — All features run entirely within your browser. Nothing is sent to external servers unless explicitly mentioned.
- No Tracking — No browsing history, cookies, or user activity is tracked.

### Permissions
- Extensions may request limited permissions (scripting, storage, host access) strictly to enable functionality.
- Permissions are never misused to access or transmit private data.
- All permission requests are clearly explained in the Chrome Web Store listing.

### Third Parties
- No data is shared with advertisers, analytics providers, or any third-party services.
- Extensions are fully self-contained with no hidden trackers.

### Security
- Any generated or processed data (e.g., passwords, temporary inputs) remains on your device.
- Data is cleared when you close, reset, or uninstall the extension.

Contact: to@codeguyakash.in | https://codeguyakash.in
Last updated: June 2026

## PAGE: Cancellation & Refund Policy
URL: https://codeguyakash.github.io/refund_policy.html

This policy applies to all Chrome extensions developed and published by
CODEGUYAKASH.

### Nature of Products
All products are digital Chrome extensions. Once installed or downloaded,
they cannot be returned or refunded due to the nature of digital goods.

### Refund Eligibility
Refunds are generally not provided after purchase. Exceptions:
- Accidental duplicate purchase on the same account.
- Technical issues preventing installation or activation.
- Unauthorized transaction or billing error verified by payment processor.

### Requesting a Refund
Contact to@codeguyakash.in with:
- Transaction ID or proof of purchase
- Name of the extension
- Description of the issue

All refund requests are reviewed within 5–7 business days. Submitting a
request does not guarantee approval.

### Policy Changes
This policy may be updated to align with new payment regulations.
The latest version will always be available on this site and the Chrome Web Store.

## PAGE: Privacy Policy — Secure Pass Extension
URL: https://codeguyakash.github.io/sprivacy.html

This Privacy Policy applies to all Chrome extensions by Akash (codeguyakash),
with particular reference to the Secure Pass extension.

### Data Collection & Usage
- No Personal Data Collected — The extension does not collect, transmit, or store any PII.
- Local Functionality — Password generation runs entirely within your browser. Nothing is sent externally.
- No Tracking — No browsing history, cookies, or activity is tracked.

### Permissions
- Limited permissions (scripting, storage) are requested strictly to enable functionality.
- Permissions are never misused to access or transmit private data.

### Third Parties
- No data is shared with third parties.
- The extension is fully self-contained with no hidden trackers or analytics.

### Security
- Generated passwords and data remain on your device only.
- Data is cleared when you close, reset, or uninstall the extension.
- For long-term storage, use a dedicated password manager.

### Secure Pass on Chrome Web Store
https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/secure-pass/ngfjlnlliapgjpcldjgblbmakhijgnhi

A: No. None of the extensions or apps collect, transmit, or store any personally identifiable

Q: Is there physical shipping for codeguyakash products?
A: No. All products are digital Chrome extensions or Android apps with instant access upon installation/download.

Q: What technologies does codeguyakash use?
